name: Paper doc page writes itself
oneLiner: a sheet of real paper with a doc editor bar lands out of depth, the heading types letter by letter behind a caret, three bullets write themselves word by word, then a highlighter sweeps one line and the page answers with a small punch
say: when the speaker talks about writing the plan, an outline, or an AI drafting a document ('it wrote the whole plan', 'step one, step two'): one bullet per step they name, the highlighter lands on the step that matters
